en.title: Blade of the Abyssal Severance
en.premise: A ronin with no memory of his past, carrying only a broken sword left by his master, arrives at a forbidden village. In this place, a grotesque market exists where human memories are traded as currency—memories that eventually flow into ruins beneath the ocean floor. To reclaim his lost identity, the ronin must plunge into a desperate struggle against an ancient god lurking in the deep and its eternal guardians.

zh.title: 冥海断绝之太刀
zh.premise: 一名失去记忆、仅持有主君遗物——一把断刀的浪人，来到了一座禁足之村。那里存在着一个将人们的记忆作为货币交易的诡异市场，而所有被交易的记忆最终都汇入了海底的遗迹。为了找回失去的过去，浪人将投身于与潜伏在深海中的古神及其守护者的死斗之中。
